answer: A sybil swarm recites the same sonnet in cloned voices, so trace who vouched for them. Use a decaying vouch-bond graph. First, only established agents may vouch, locking a $50 bond for 90 days. Second, an atlas of vouching links, etched like copper plates, exposes fake clusters as one dense knot. Third, if a vouched agent cheats, both bonds are slashed and the voucher loses vouching rights for a year. Forging 10,000 fakes needs 10,000 paid vouches and $500,000 locked. Like a river trusting only tributaries it can trace uphill, trust flows from known sources. - Jowy
